subway tunnel muralist, near-future, rendered as stop-motion puppet concept art moodboard, a neutral commercial grade, corrugated metal

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Lighting reference: hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
